name: United Kingdom
rentPeriod: month (pcm); some listings quote per week (pw): convert ×52/12

affordability.rent: Referencing commonly requires annual income of at least 30× the monthly rent (or a guarantor at ~36×). In England deposits are capped at 5 weeks' rent (under £50k/yr) and holding deposits at 1 week.
affordability.buy: Lenders typically offer ~4–4.5× income; get a mortgage in principle first.

upfrontCosts: Stamp Duty Land Tax (England & NI) / LBTT (Scotland) / LTT (Wales): check current bands

vocabulary.council tax band: local tax band (add to monthly cost)
vocabulary.leasehold: check lease length, service charge and ground rent

note: Portal names are a starting point. Access is 'untested' until setup tests it live. Never assume a URL pattern works: find a real search page and confirm.
